verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs say it provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and OpenAI-compatible APIs. They also present it as a drop-in replacement in a "Migrate from OpenAI" guide, tell users to point their client at api.fireworks.ai, and note that tool specifications are OpenAI-compatible. Together that directly covers swapping an OpenAI SDK client over to Fireworks. Missing for 10: an explicit documented snippet showing that only base_url and api_key change in the official OpenAI SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration that existing OpenAI SDK clients work unmodified.
